name: Breast cancer survivor medical-bill hardship risk (demo)
outcome: Problems paying medical bills, past 12 months
train_data: NHIS Sample Adult 2021-2024, adults with breast cancer history
external_data: MEPS HC-256 2024, adults with breast cancer (CABREAST=1)

model_selection.rule: M1 unless M2 CV AUC >= M1 + 0.02

excluded_features_and_why.years_since_diagnosis: NHIS-only; not available in MEPS, excluded from portable model
excluded_features_and_why.high_deductible_plan: NHIS-only; not available in MEPS, excluded from portable model
excluded_features_and_why.urban_rural: URBRRL not on the 2024 NHIS public file

metrics.meps_auc_ci_method: percentile bootstrap, 1000 person resamples, weighted AUC

risk_tiers.method: weighted tertiles of predicted risk, NHIS training data

intended_use: Education and screening demonstration for a student datathon. Not for clinical or financial decisions.
limitations: insurance and outcome definitions differ slightly across surveys
NHIS insurance is coverage at interview; MEPS is ever-covered in 2024
outcome refers to the respondent's family in both surveys
male survivors (n=36) included in NHIS training

65+ insurance split is not like-for-like: medicare_plus_private is 49.2% of 65+ in NHIS training (unweighted) vs 35.0% in the MEPS external set; MEPS PRVEV24 is ever-private in 2024 and Medigap/Medicare Advantage may be classified differently
missing_data: most-frequent (binary/categorical) or median (age) imputation inside the pipeline; no feature >5% missing, so no missing indicators
nhis_cv_ci_note: ml_metrics nhis_cv ci_lo/ci_hi = mean -/+ 1 SD over 5 folds
fpl_guidelines: 2024 HHS poverty guidelines, 48 contiguous states + DC: $15,060 + $5,380 per extra person; AK/HI not handled
